function.name: get_order_status
function.description: Live status of a JOOLA web order from the store: payment status, fulfilment status, items, shipments with carrier, tracking number and tracking link, and any returns. Use when the customer asks where their order is, whether it shipped, for tracking, or about a return. First ask for the order number AND either the email address or the postcode used on the order, then call this tool. Returns { enabled, status, order }. status 'ok': give the status in plain words; read a tracking number only if asked, and offer to email the tracking link. 'needs_verification': ask for the email or postcode on the order. 'not_found': say you couldn't match that order number with those details, ask them to check both once, and never say whether the order exists. 'invalid_order_number': ask them to repeat the order number (it has 3 or more digits, e.g. 5301). 'too_many_attempts': say you can't verify by postcode right now and ask for the email address on the order instead. If enabled is false or status is 'unavailable' or 'disabled', use lookup_order instead, or offer to have the team follow up by email. Never read out addresses or payment details.

order_number.description: The order number as the customer said it, e.g. '5301' or '#5301'.

email.description: Email address on the order, if the customer gave it.

postcode.description: Shipping or billing postcode / ZIP on the order, if the customer gave it instead of the email.
